# The Graph crate formats generated output after manual generation

For the manual Graph generator path, this crate's README says output has no formatting by default and calls for clippy fixes and cargo fmt before review or commit. The one-file follow-up only reorders an existing generated import. It does not require changing generator logic or establish a rule for other generated files. Current typed imports and owned Message fields belong to later phases.

Scope: Microsoft Graph generated-source workflow.
